name: Clarksville (United States)
description: The town arms in banner form: red over dark blue divided by a white wavy line for the Ohio River, a red cross of St George fimbriated in white in the upper part and a yellow sword over all, recalling George Rogers Clark.
history: Clarksville is a town in Clark County, Indiana, along the Ohio River and is a part of the Louisville Metropolitan area. The flag was adopted in 1968 (designed by Richard M. Crossett after a 1968 contest sponsored by the Clarksville Business and Professional Women's Club, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: wavy division line for the Ohio River
